repository.name: @webex/plugin-authorization
repository.purpose: Environment-selecting entry for webex.authorization. Its Node entry (main dist/index.js, devMain src/index.js) re-exports default and config from @webex/plugin-authorization-node; its package.json browser field maps both the built and the source Node entry to a browser entry that re-exports them from @webex/plugin-authorization-browser. Importing the package imports the selected sibling, which registers itself as public plugin 'authorization' (first registration wins). webex, webex-node, @webex/contact-center, @webex/plugin-device-manager, and @webex/plugin-encryption import it once to obtain webex.authorization. The package has no behavior, state, or tests of its own.

authorization-sdk.summary: Published npm package. main is dist/index.js and devMain is src/index.js (Node entry, re-exporting default and config from @webex/plugin-authorization-node); the browser field maps ./dist/index.js to ./dist/index.browser.js and ./src/index.js to ./src/index.browser.js (browser entry, re-exporting them from @webex/plugin-authorization-browser). Exports are default and config, mirroring the selected sibling. Importing the package registers the selected sibling as public plugin 'authorization' (first registration wins). Per-entry behavior is in src/docs/README.md.

authorization-node-sdk.summary: Exports default Authorization and config {credentials: {}}; importing it imports @webex/internal-plugin-device and registers 'authorization' with proxies isAuthorizing and isAuthenticating. Plugin API: requestAuthorizationCodeGrant, requestAccessTokenFromJwt, createJwt, logout.

authorization-browser-sdk.source: @webex/plugin-authorization-browser (workspace package; no specification exists, code consulted: packages/@webex/plugin-authorization-browser/src/index.js, src/config.js, src/authorization.js, package.json)
authorization-browser-sdk.summary: Exports default Authorization and config {credentials: {clientType: 'public'}}; importing it imports @webex/internal-plugin-device and registers 'authorization' with proxies isAuthorizing and isAuthenticating. Plugin API: initiateLogin (authorization-code redirect when clientType is 'confidential', else implicit grant), initiateImplicitGrant, initiateAuthorizationCodeGrant, requestAccessTokenFromJwt, createJwt, logout; on initialization it parses the URL hash for a token and checks the sessionStorage CSRF token.

webex-core-plugin-host.summary: registerPlugin(name, ctor, options) is first-wins: a second registration of a name already registered returns without changing anything unless options.replace is set (MOD-013). Reached by this package only through the sibling plugins' import side effects.

package-browser-field-resolution.source: package.json browser field convention as applied by webpack (resolve.aliasFields) and browserify; the workspace build is the root webpack.config.js, which aliases each workspace package to src/index
package-browser-field-resolution.summary: A resolver that applies the browser field replaces ./dist/index.js and ./src/index.js with their .browser.js counterparts. Node require does not apply it. The committed packages/webex/umd/webex.min.js shows the workspace build applies it.
